eventLocation: ?"Mullu Kuttai" pond in Thirumukkoodal village, Salavakkam Union, Kanchipuram District.
eventName: Restoration work of the ?Mullu Kuttai? pond
eventDescription:
With the financial support of Puthiya Thalaimurai Television, the restoration work of the ?Mullu Kuttai? pond in Thirumukkoodal village, Salavakkam Union, Kanchipuram District, was carried out for over 10 days and has now been successfully completed.

Let us revive the buried and forgotten water bodies!
